test_records.MQL: db.harvests.aggregate([ { $group: { _id: "$crop", p50: { $percentile: { input: "$rainfall_mm", p: [0.5], method: "approximate" } }, p95: { $percentile: { input: "$rainfall_mm", p: [0.95], method: "approximate" } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, crop: "$_id", p50: 1, p95: 1 } }])

known_variants: db.harvests.aggregate([ { $group: { _id: "$crop", p50: { $percentile: { input: "$rainfall_mm", p: [0.5], method: "approximate" } }, p95: { $percentile: { input: "$rainfall_mm", p: [0.95], method: "approximate" } } } }, { $project: { _id: 0, crop: "$_id", p50: 1, p95: 1 } }])
